item.text: The loader owns a mutable parser source cache, and `Sources()` reads from that parser. I’m reading the loader implementation and local backend run path to see whether there is already a snapshot or copy boundary that should be used.

The parser itself has a mutex, but `Sources()` returns the underlying source map, so a caller can race later while another goroutine parses. The correct boundary is probably to prevent long-running graph loads from mutating the same loader the view reads from.
